scripts.serve: npm run build && dotnet run --project src/Server/Server.fsproj
scripts.desktop: npm run build && dotnet run --project src/Desktop/Desktop.fsproj
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && dotnet publish src/Desktop/Desktop.fsproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o deploy/desktop/win-x64
scripts.desktop:publish:mac: npm run build && dotnet publish src/Desktop/Desktop.fsproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true -o deploy/desktop/osx-arm64
scripts.deploy: docker build -t mediatheca:latest . && docker save mediatheca:latest -o mediatheca.tar
